_note: Money in the game (garage/player). Prices are the parts' and cars' own (their files). Selling: price × sell.ratio × the condition curve at the part's condition (straight lines between the points). Repairing to 100%: price × repair.perPoint × the points missing, at least repair.minimum (dents with no points missing: the minimum). The body shell repairs the same way from its own price (car.json shell.price), plus repair.breakable for each broken window or light. A part with mechanical damage (bent, leaking, worn: garage/mechanical.js) costs price × repair.mechanical more to put right (at least repair.minimum). Parts that go on a group of sockets (wheels, tyres, spacers) are bought as a set of that many. A new car costs its class's carPrices × its priceFactor (car.json).

repair._note: garage/repair.js. A car's damage is repaired a piece at a time (the damage report's problems) or all at once. full: back to 100%, every dent out, the mechanical damage gone. quick: share of the full price; condition up to quick.condition (never down), each dent dentScale as hard (those left shallower than dentMin m gone), leaks sealed and tyres pumped up, bends and wear mechanicalKept of what they were. Mechanical damage: the part's price × its system's share (systems; mechanical for any not listed) — a corner of a per-wheel system (suspension, brake lines) a quarter of it — at least minimum, from severity of it for a slight one up to all of it at the worst. reattach: of the part's price, bolting a part that came loose or off back on (the same either way). A part's repairs together never cost more than maxOfNew of a new one. Fitting a spare from the inventory instead is free, like fitting any part.

safetyNet._note: garage/repair.js basicRepair. A car that can't carry on (data/damage.json drivable) whose player can't afford the quick repairs that would make it drivable gets a basic repair free: only what stops it, each value put inside its limit (margin of it), a wheel back on, a blown engine running again at engineCondition.

raceRewards._note: Placeholder prize money (races come later): what the balance report weighs crash repairs against.
